The product telescopes:
\[
a_1a_2\cdots a_k=\log_2(k+2).
\]
For this to be an integer, let
\[
\log_2(k+2)=m \implies k+2=2^m.
\]
Since \(k\in[1,2015]\),
\[
2^m-2 \le 2015 \implies 2^m\le 2017.
\]
Thus \(m=2,3,\dots,10\). Sum of all such \(k\):
\[
\sum_{m=2}^{10}(2^m-2)
=(2^{11}-4)-18
=2044-18=2026.
\]
\[
\boxed{2026}
\]
